title: Minimum Sum of Mountain Triplets I
sourceKind: web-search-snippets (official page not fetchable; snippets cite leetcode.com and mirrors)
summary: A mountain triplet is indices i < j < k with nums[i] < nums[j] and nums[k] < nums[j]. Return the minimum nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k], or -1 if none exists.
officialConstraints: 3 <= n <= 50; 1 <= nums[i] <= 50 (as reported by search snippets; not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Per-peak scan for cheapest smaller partners on each side. Examples come from search snippets, not a fetched statement, so they are not marked as verified.
